name: What You've Always Wanted
source:
You are a scientist on the edge of a monumental breakthrough. Your boss asks you to a moonlit dinner on a rooftop. You're ecstatic. However, your boss seems just slightly off.

[From [url=https://leeelee0123.itch.io/what-youve-always-want]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名科学家，距离一项重大突破只有一步之遥。上司邀你在月光下共进屋顶晚餐，你欣喜若狂。可是，上司似乎有那么一点点不对劲。

［摘自[url=https://leeelee0123.itch.io/what-youve-always-want]itch.io[/url]］
